name: Dark Life [Beta]
desc:
The game is like DarkRP, Da hood, build a boat
You have to build bases and protect your money printers and bitcoin 
Take your earnings in your wallet to the deposit button on the map to pay money into your bank. 
If your killed the money in your wallet drops 
Money in the bank is Safe

Use the money to get big weapons and upgrade your base and weapons
Update 1.21:
Optimization of models gaster and other guns
Optimization of Map Models 
Fixed to anti-cheat
Fixed Fall death out of the map
Fixed Lag
Fixed all explosive damage hurting yourself (And Gasters)
Added Stomp self
Fix Glass in jewellery store
More is coming

scripts.title: Grab Money
scripts.features: automatically Grabs Dropped money and deposit it
scripts.script:
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(moneybag)
    if moneybag.Name =="Money_Bag" then
        wait(0.2)
        firetouchinterest(moneybag.Outer,  game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart, 0)
        wait()
        firetouchinterest(moneybag.Outer,  game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart, 1)
        wait(0.2)
        firetouchinterest(game:GetService("Workspace").Deposit.Collider,  game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart, 0)
        wait()
        firetouchinterest(game:GetService("Workspace").Deposit.Collider,  game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart, 1)
    end
end)
